title: Compute Decision Cheat Sheet — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Step-by-Step Compute Selection Flow: question prompt analysis -> container status -> protocol check -> execution duration -> optimal compute product.
routing_rationale: Following the structured compute decision tree eliminates hesitation on exam scenarios.

nodes.label: Is Application Containerized?
nodes.detail: Yes: Application packaged as Docker container.

nodes.label: Protocol: HTTP/gRPC or Custom TCP?
nodes.detail: Responds to HTTPS webhooks within 60 minutes.

nodes.label: Operational Requirement: Minimal Ops
nodes.detail: Eliminates GKE Standard and Compute Engine due to node maintenance.

nodes.label: Result: Cloud Run Fully Managed
nodes.detail: Optimal GCP compute choice meeting all requirements with zero idle cost.

steps.title: Final Selection
steps.action: Applies operational filter: selects Cloud Run as winning product.
steps.why_traversal: Aligns with PCA exam scoring rubric.

scenarios.label: Workload Exceeds 60-Minute Cloud Run Timeout
scenarios.root_cause: Job was an 8-hour batch video render; Cloud Run killed execution at 60-minute limit.
scenarios.recovery: Route long-running batch jobs to Cloud Batch or Cloud Run Jobs with extended execution timeouts.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
